entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. I don't have a lot of time.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF789-012. It's a pair of cycling shoes. Can I get a refund or not?
Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They don't fit. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but after one ride, they're already causing blisters. They're just not right for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters. That sounds uncomfortable. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see they were delivered 9 days ago.
You're all set. According to our policy, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day window for a return. I can definitely cannot offer a refund for those cycling shoes.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, have a great day.
